worldcombat.skill.pyroball.summary: Ignites a small stone and kicks it as a fiery ball: it arcs out trailing flame, bursts into fire and shards on impact, may set the target alight, and leaves a scorch that fades on the ground.
worldcombat.skill.pyroball.use.0: A high-power fireball shot at medium range
worldcombat.skill.pyroball.use.1: Chip with a driven shot that may ignite
worldcombat.skill.pyroball.use.2: Leave a scorch at the landing to mark the kick
worldcombat.skill.pyroball.description.0: The ball flies on a low arc at %2$s with a %3$s block radius, dealing %1$s physical damage on a hit; it can drift up to %4$s degrees off the aim.
worldcombat.skill.pyroball.description.1: A hit has a %1$s chance to ignite the target.
worldcombat.skill.pyroball.savage.on: Wild kick: power x1.1, burn chance +4%%, a bigger scorch, but scatter +6 degrees, range -1.5 blocks and a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.pyroball.savage.off: Driven shot: straighter, farther and faster, at the cost of slightly lower power and ignition.
worldcombat.skill.pyroball.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.pyroball.growth.0: From level %1$s the fireball rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of range.
worldcombat.skill.pyroball.growth.1: From level %1$s the fireball rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.pyroball.preference.sa: On: power x1.1, burn chance +4%%, but scatter +6 degrees (harder to aim), range -1.5 blocks, +3 wind-up and +8 cooldown. Off (driven shot): straighter, farther and faster, at the cost of slightly lower power and ignition.
worldcombat.skill.pyroball.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: low-health targets rank first, finishing them with the heavy fireball; off: order by ordinary ranged attack only.
